unit_configs.cmd:
SCRIPT_PATH=/workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts

export PYTHONHASHSEED=1234
export log_level_proxy=info
export core_num=4
export start_core_index=16
export pd_policy=sequential

TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 bash "${SCRIPT_PATH}/proxy.sh" \
  --log-level info \
  --core-num 4 \
  --start-core-index 16 \
  --subrequest-output-buffer-size 10M \
  --omni-proxy-pd-policy sequential \
  --omni-proxy-max-batch-num-token 100000 \
  --omni-proxy-prefill-max-num-seqs 4 \
  --omni-proxy-decode-max-num-seqs 3 &&

export OMNI_NPU_USE_DEVICE_COMM_A2A=1
export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=2
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=100
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=1800
export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=1800
export HCCL_OP_RETRY_ENABLE="L0:0,L1:0,L2:0"
export ASCEND_GLOBAL_LOG_LEVEL=3
export OMNI_PIGGYBACK_INPUT_IDS=1
export OMNI_SKIP_DECODE_TOKENIZE=0
export VLLM_MQ_MAX_CHUNK_BYTES_MB=100
export VLLM_PLUGINS="omni-npu,omni_pangu_models,omni_npu_patches,omni_custom_models"
export OMNI_HYBRID_ATTN_GROUP_SIZE=17
export OMNI_VLLM_PATCHES_DIR="pangu_v2_hybrid, pangu_v2_moe"
export OMNI_VLLM_PATCHES="ALL"
export OMNI_CUSTOM_MODEL_CONFIG_PATH="low_latency/openpangu_v2/pangu_v2_moe_bf16_a3_92B_xp1d_p_open.json"
export OMNI_PANGU_TOOL_CALL_ENDS_THINKING=1
export TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE=1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export gpu_util=0.85
export max_num_seqs=12
export max_num_batched_tokens=16384
export kv_offload=false
export hugepage_enabled=true
export cpu_bytes_to_use=858993459200

bash "${SCRIPT_PATH}/prefill.sh" \
  --block-size 128 \
  --mamba-block-size 128 \
  --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --max-num-seqs 12 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --enforce-eager \
  --kv-cache-dtype li_int8_ds_mla \
  --reasoning-parser pangu \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser pangu \
  --enable-lopt --lopt-pool-size 16 \
  --lopt-chunk-size 4096 \
  --enable-log-requests --enable-log-outputs --enable-logging-iteration-details \
  --reasoning-config '{"reasoning_start_str":"<think>","reasoning_end_str":"</think>","ban_sequence_end_in_thinking":true}' \
  --max-model-len 524288 \
  --additional-config '{"enable_low_latency": true}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' && sleep infinity
unit_configs.name: prefill
